hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester one builds financial literacy and digital marketing foundations while developing communication, AI literacy, global awareness, and career planning skills for future managers.

courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.

title.strong: Modern Age AI Tools (Generative AI Tools)

courses.text: Explores emerging generative AI technologies, enabling students to apply automation, innovation, and creativity in solving complex business problems across industries.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development I: Career Planning and Goal Setting

courses.text: Focuses on self-awareness, career planning, and effective goal setting, guiding students toward professional growth, leadership readiness, and future career opportunities.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

courses.title: Marketing – The 21st Century Marketing
courses.text: Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

courses.title: Entrepreneurship & Family Business – Entrepreneurship and Family Business 101
courses.text: Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

title.strong: Business Analytics – Driving Decisions by Excel (Basics & Advanced)

courses.text: Master Excel tools from basics to advanced analytics, learning data organization, visualization, forecasting, and decision modeling to transform raw data into actionable business insights.

title.strong: Digital Marketing & Advertising – Introduction to Digital Marketing

courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME combines practical finance and digital marketing skills with AI and communication training, unlike traditional MBAs’ theory-focused and less tech-integrated approach.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Semester two enhances leadership, creativity, and sustainability while strengthening financial expertise and building entrepreneurial innovation, succession planning, and technology-driven business strategies.

courses.text: Focuses on emotional intelligence, motivation, and conflict resolution. Builds leadership capacity and teamwork effectiveness through workshops, peer projects, and reflective practices.
Encourages creative problem-solving through empathy, ideation, prototyping, and testing. Applies design thinking to entrepreneurial, financial, and organisational challenges.
Explores corporate responsibility and sustainability alongside research methods. Encourages data-driven insights to design socially impactful and ethical business solutions.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development II: Personal Branding & Professional Networking

courses.text: Guides students to build authentic professional identities. Involves mentoring, digital branding, and simulated networking with industry leaders.

items.title: Investment Analysis & Portfolio Management
items.text: Equips students to evaluate securities, construct portfolios, and manage investment risk. Emphasises financial modelling and applied decision-making in volatile markets.
Covers capital budgeting, cost of capital, working capital, and corporate financing decisions. Strengthens strategic financial decision-making skills.
Explores banking, regulatory structures, and capital markets in India. Provides insights into financial institutions and instruments unique to the Indian context.

items.title: Wealth Management
items.text: Covers personal finance, estate planning, taxation, and investment strategies. Prepares students for financial advisory and wealth planning roles.
Explores modern business model innovation, startup strategies, and disruptive ventures. Students design scalable models incorporating technology, customer insights, and financial viability.
Covers governance, succession planning, and operational challenges of family businesses. Students analyze case studies and develop strategic solutions for real-world family enterprises.
Focuses on creating long-term strategies tailored to family businesses. Covers governance frameworks, visioning, and succession alignment.
Introduces digital tools and emerging technologies that support innovation, scalability, and efficiency in entrepreneurial ventures.

compare.title: Why our semester 2 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME integrates sustainability, applied finance, and entrepreneurial family business strategy, unlike conventional MBAs which emphasise siloed theory with little real-world application.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Semester three deepens ethical leadership, resilience, and economic decision-making while advancing financial modelling expertise and entrepreneurial innovation within family and startup ecosystems.

title.strong: Organisational Behaviour and Universal Human Values

courses.text: Explores workplace dynamics, motivation, and culture, integrating ethical values and human-centric leadership approaches for sustainable, inclusive organisational development.
Introduces cyber risk governance, data security, and compliance. Emphasises strategies for protecting digital assets and ensuring resilience in technology-driven business ecosystems.
Applies micro and macroeconomic concepts to managerial challenges. Focuses on cost analysis, market structures, policy impact, and forecasting for strategic planning.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development III: Emotional Intelligence & Resilience

courses.text: Strengthens emotional intelligence and adaptability. Uses simulations, feedback, and coaching to cultivate resilient leaders who thrive under pressure and uncertainty.

items.title: Financial Modelling
items.text: Develops quantitative skills for building valuation, forecasting, and decision-making models. Uses Excel and financial software for applied business case simulations.

items.title: Corporate Finance
items.text: Learn strategies to influence, negotiate, and resolve conflicts effectively. Apply practical techniques to achieve results in business and leadership scenarios.
Provides tools to analyse stock movements, interpret charts, and apply trading strategies in volatile markets.
Examines funding strategies, venture capital, angel investing, and financial decision-making for startups and early-stage ventures.
Introduces strategies for customer acquisition, pipeline building, and scaling sales in entrepreneurial contexts.
Focuses on growth strategies, partnerships, and innovative business development approaches for startups and family businesses.

title.strong: Innovation & Technological Adaptation in Family Enterprise

items.text: Explores digital transformation, new technologies, and innovation frameworks tailored to family businesses.
Covers agile marketing and scaling strategies using cost-effective, data-driven methods for rapid growth.

title.strong: Legal Compliance & Leadership in Family Enterprise

items.text: Examines legal frameworks, compliance requirements, and leadership practices specific to family-owned businesses.

compare.title: Why our semester 3 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME integrates ethics, resilience, and applied finance with entrepreneurial sales, innovation, and family enterprise strategies, unlike MBAs focusing mainly on siloed theory.

Financial modelling, corporate finance, market analysis, and entrepreneurial finance taught through simulations, trading labs, and venture capital case studies.

semesters.title: Semester 4
semesters.text: Semester four integrates governance, corporate strategy, valuation, and fintech innovation with entrepreneurial leadership, resilience, and consultancy for family enterprises navigating growth and transformation.

courses.text: Explores governance frameworks, regulatory compliance, and professional ethics. Emphasises accountability, transparency, and legal structures shaping corporate conduct in globalised business contexts.

Introduces data-driven optimisation of logistics, procurement, and distribution. Applies predictive modelling and technology-enabled solutions for efficiency, sustainability, and resilience in supply chain management.
Covers competitive advantage, diversification, M&A, and global expansion. Uses real-world cases and simulations to develop long-term strategic decision-making skills.

title.strong:
Career & Leadership Development IV: Diversity, Equity,
& Inclusion in Leadership, & Capstone

courses.text: Focuses on inclusive leadership and organisational equity. Culminates in a capstone project synthesising knowledge, leadership, and practical application.

items.text: Explores valuation models, DCF analysis, multiples, and market-based methods. Builds expertise in determining enterprise value for investments, mergers, and acquisitions.
Examines digital financial innovations—blockchain, mobile payments, robo-advisory, and AI—alongside entrepreneurial approaches to launching FinTech startups.

items.title: Sustainable Finance
items.text: Introduces ESG investing, green bonds, and impact finance. Students integrate sustainability into financial strategies and long-term corporate value creation.

items.title: Behavioural Finance
items.text: Studies investor psychology, cognitive biases, and irrational market behavior. Students apply behavioral principles to improve corporate and investment decisions.
Develops leadership capabilities specific to founders and family enterprises. Emphasises vision, adaptability, and decision-making under uncertainty.

title.strong: Ethics, Governance & Social Responsibility in Family Enterprise

items.text: Explore how to evaluate assets, construct portfolios, and optimize returns. Gain practical insights into risk, performance, and market strategies.
Students consult real or simulated family businesses, diagnosing challenges, recommending strategies, and developing operational or strategic solutions.
Explores risk management, failure analysis, and recovery strategies. Students learn resilience, pivot strategies, and lessons from entrepreneurial setbacks.
